The '''1975–76 Cypriot First Division''' was the 37th season of the Cypriot top-level [[Association football|football]] league.

==Overview==
It was contested by 15 teams, and [[AC Omonia]] won the championship. The top scorer that season was [[Sotiris Kaiafas]] with 39 goals, who ended up winning the season's [[European Golden Shoe]], that made him the only [[Cyprus|Cypriot]] to have won the award.
